audit.action: NOT AUDITED: input lib-graph.json missing; zero proposals emitted. Spot checks of the producer's summary claims: WinMain=0x005631f0 is supported (called only by CRT entry 0x0067bbe0; WinMain-shaped args; calls utyGameSystemsInit plus PeekMessage/DispatchMessage), but it conflicts with CET's patch-site-derived name InitWindow (HW1 SDL/main.c:1948 static InitWindow is inlined into it). _Xlen 0x00693dc7 ('string too long') and _Xran 0x00693ff3 ('invalid string position') are supported. Zero functions exist in the claimed KAS zone 0x5d6fe0-0x670a0f. Zone counts match functions.csv (jpeg 105, crt 569, won 1711, magick 392, iostream 691, crt2 48, eh 2343). The layering premise ('library only calls library') is leaky: _Xlen/_Xran call std::string helpers FUN_00554760/FUN_00554150 in the game zone, which are COMDAT template instantiations. 214 functions in .cms_t/.data (0x891a1c-0xc67ca0) fall outside every claimed zone.
